title: Zoning text change for housing at 50-20 108th Street, Queens
summary: This resolution approves a zoning text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 50-20 108th Street in Corona, Queens. It works together with a related zoning map amendment to enable two new mixed-use buildings with about 196 apartments, 51 of which would be income-restricted. The Council held a public hearing on June 17, 2026 before approving the change.
